sections.shortTitle: Security of Pakistan Second Amendment Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Savings

THE SECURITY OF PAKISTAN (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959
THE SECURITY OF PAKISTAN (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No.
XXXIX of 1959
[20th July, 1959]
An Ordinance further to amend the Security of Pakistan Act, 1952
6. Savings.--Anything
done, action taken, order passed, appointment made, or direction issued, or
purporting to have been done, taken, passed, made or issued, under the said Act
on or after the tenth day of October, 1958, shall be deemed to have been done,
taken, passed, made or issued, as the case may be, under the said Act as amended
by this Ordinance, and shall have and shall be deemed always to have had,
effect accordingly.
